name: Block Animations – WordPress Animation Plugin for Gutenberg
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Add stunning animations to your Gutenberg blocks with Block Animations, the ultimate WordPress animation plugin.

Elevate your WordPress website with the free Block Animations plugin, designed to seamlessly integrate with the Gutenberg editor.

With 20 pre-defined animation effects, you can easily create captivating animations for your blocks and preview them directly within the Block Editor. This plugin supports custom animations and includes basic optimization features to ensure smooth performance without compromising your website’s speed.

Transform your content effortlessly and enhance your site’s visual appeal with Block Animations today!

USAGE

  1. Install: Get the plugin directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory or upload the ZIP file through your WordPress admin panel.
  2. Activate: Enable the plugin and navigate to the Block Editor.
  3. Select and Animate: Choose the block you want to enhance, then access the animation options in the block settings or toolbar. Pick from 20 pre-defined effects or create custom animations to match your needs.
  4. Preview and Refine: Use the Block Editor’s built-in preview mode to see how your animations will look on your website.
  5. Unlock More Features: For advanced animation capabilities, extended block support, and priority assistance, upgrade to Animate Blocks Pro and take your animations to the next level.

FEATURES & LIMITATIONS

Key Features:

  • Custom Animation Block: Easily create custom animations for supported blocks.
  • Supported Blocks: Apply animations to a limited selection of block types.
  • Block Preview Mode: Visualize animations in real time within the Block Editor.
  • Animation Effects: Enjoy 20 pre-defined effects to enhance your content.
  • Reset All Blocks: Clear animations across all blocks with a single click.
  • Reduce Page Loading: Optimize performance by loading animations only when needed.
  • Regular Plugin Updates: Stay compatible with WordPress updates with routine plugin improvements.

Limitations:

  • Custom Animation Editor: Direct animation customization within the editor is not available.
  • User-Defined Blocks: You cannot define custom blocks for animations.
  • Animation Global Settings: Global control over animation settings is unavailable.
  • Overflow Hidden to Parent Elements: This feature is not supported in the free version.
  • Video and Gallery Blocks: Animating video and gallery blocks is restricted to the Pro version.
  • Advanced Animation Options: Features like “once” and “mirror” animations are not accessible.
  • Search Animation Effects: Searching for specific effects using tools like Select2 is not supported.
  • Priority Email Support: Support is provided but without priority status.
  • Enhanced Performance and Recovery: Advanced performance optimizations and faster recovery tools are unavailable.

DETAILED DOCUMENTATION

The step-by-step setup, usage, demos, video, and insights can be found on Animate Blocks Pro.

ANIMATE BLOCKS PRO

  1. Custom Animation Editor: Fully customize animations directly within the editor for precise design control and seamless integration.
  2. User-Defined Blocks: Apply animations to custom block types for greater creative freedom.
  3. Extended Supported Blocks: Animate a wide variety of block types, including advanced and multimedia blocks.
  4. Animation Global Settings: Manage animations across your entire site with centralized global settings.
  5. Overflow Hidden to Parent Elements: Eliminate unwanted visual disruptions with overflow control.
  6. Video and Gallery Blocks: Add animations to video and gallery blocks to captivate your audience with engaging visuals.
  7. Animation Effects Library: Access a vast library of over 100 pre-defined animation effects to enhance your content.
  8. Once and Mirror Animation Options: Use advanced triggers like “once” and “mirror” to create sophisticated animation effects.
  9. Reset All Blocks: Streamline animation management by resetting animations for all blocks in one click.
  10. Search Animation Effects with Select2: Quickly locate and apply animation effects using the intuitive Select2 search tool.
  11. Reduce Page Loading: Optimize site performance by loading animations on demand.
  12. Priority Email Support: Receive prompt assistance with priority email support for quick issue resolution.
  13. Regular Plugin Updates: Stay ahead with frequent updates, ensuring compatibility with the latest WordPress versions and new features.
sections.installation:
Installing Block Animations is straightforward and user-friendly. Follow the steps below to get started. If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out for support.

Installation from WordPress:

  1. Navigate to your WordPress admin dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Block Editor Animations in the plugin directory.
  3. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.
  4. Access settings via Themes > Animate Blocks or directly from the Animate Blocks menu.

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin and unzip the block-editor-animations folder.
  2. Upload the folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory on your server.
  3. Go to the Plugins menu in your WordPress dashboard and activate Block Editor Animations.
  4. Access settings through Themes > Animate Blocks or the Animate Blocks menu.

After Activation:

  1. Open any page or post in the Block Editor.
  2. Select a supported block to reveal the additional Animation tab in the block settings.
  3. Use the available controls to apply animations to your content.
sections.faq:
Can I customize animations for specific blocks?

Yes, you can create custom animations for supported blocks within the free version of the plugin.

What blocks are supported for applying animations?

The free version supports a limited selection of block types, including:
– Design: core/group, core/column, core/columns
– Media: core/image
– Text: core/heading, core/paragraph, core/button

Need more? Upgrade to Animate Blocks Pro for extended block support.

Is there a preview mode to see how animations will look within the Block Editor?

Yes, you can preview animations directly within the Block Editor to see how they will appear on your website.

How many pre-defined animation effects are available?

The free version includes 20 pre-defined animation effects. For access to over 100 effects and advanced customization options, check out Animate Blocks Pro.

Does it offer any performance optimizations for loading animations?

Yes, basic optimization features are included to load animations as needed, ensuring minimal impact on performance.

For advanced performance options, the Pro version provides on-demand animation loading and multiple settings for optimizing the core CSS file.

Is there a way to customize animation timing or effects beyond the pre-defined options?

No, the free version does not allow customization beyond the pre-defined effects. Consider Animate Blocks Pro for more advanced customization options.

Still have questions? Visit the Support page for additional help.
